== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Zeth Baker, also known simply as Zeth, is a specialized Worldweaver who was widely regarded as being talented even in his place of birth. Despite his reputation, he views his abilities as highly specific rather than broadly gifted. During a mission involving the Tanakite camp, Zeth utilized his ability to talk his way past patrols by posing as a member of their order, even going so far as to wear a stolen scarlet cloth featuring the symbol of [[Mul’Tanak]]. While he often projects an image of absolute certainty and boldness to The mask{{!}}mask his internal fears and doubts, he is capable of profound determination. In addition to his skills as a Worldweaver, Zeth has experience navigating social interactions with Tanakite soldiers and possesses the ability to read the thoughts of his enemies. His experiences have included significant physical trauma, such as a severe eye injury, though he has also experienced moments of sudden, inexplicable healing.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Zeth is a talented Worldweaver. This individual utilizes [[Pattern Construction]] to overlay reality with a [[Pattern]].}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Zeth Baker is a talented Worldweaver. He possesses the specialized ability of [[Pattern Construction]], which allows him to utilize a [[Pattern]] to overlay reality.}}
